notes: Sources changed from the 2026-08-04 build: SI, Bleacher Report and RotoBaller are gone (see sources_dropped); ESPN and Fantasy Football Calculator are new. Six sources -> five. Some rank deltas therefore reflect the changed source mix, not pure opinion movement.
Freshness: FantasyPros ECR updated 8/11, CBS retrieved 8/11, Fantasy Football Calculator updated 8/11, ESPN API retrieved 8/11, NBC/Rotoworld top-200 last modified 2026-08-06.
Fantasy Football Calculator ('ffc') is a consensus derived from live mock-draft ADP rather than one analyst's board. It is the most market-driven of the five and tends to lag on camp news.
NBC/Rotoworld publishes an overall top-200 with an explicit position-rank column, which was used directly. It therefore only reaches roughly RB64/WR88/QB24/TE24 and covers no kickers or defences.

All five sets are REDRAFT PPR. No free, machine-readable dynasty positional set was reachable this run, so the two dynasty leagues (DU & Friends, PFFP) should lean on the FantasyCalc dynasty layer in market_snapshot.json rather than this file.

Positions and display names were verified against the Sleeper player database (https://api.sleeper.app/v1/players/nfl). Display names now follow Sleeper's spelling, so some suffixes changed (e.g. 'James Cook III' -> 'James Cook'); app.js norm() strips suffixes, so cross-source joins are unaffected.
app.js line 246 hard-codes SRC = {si, nbc, br, espn}. Only the 'espn' and 'nbc' columns from this file will render in the player profile until that map is widened to read the file's own source_keys.
